headline: Istanbul Consumer Prices Rise 2.47% Month-on-Month in October
summary: Consumer prices in Istanbul increased by 2.47% month-on-month in October, according to retail price data published by the Istanbul Chamber of Commerce.
why: The Istanbul Consumer Price Index is widely viewed as a leading indicator for Turkey's official national inflation figures, shaping expectations for Central Bank of Turkey interest rate decisions.

impacts.name: Turkish Lira
impacts.why: Persistent monthly price increases in Istanbul reinforce expectations for sustained high central bank policy rates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
